_comment: Ethan Josean Perez's comments as a Manifund regrantor on projects Trace records grants for, snapshotted by scripts/fetch-manifund-comments.ts. One review per org: every comment on that org's projects, oldest first, each headed by the project and month.

reviews.review:
[CaML - AGI alignment to nonhumans](https://manifund.org/projects/caml---agi-alignment-to-nonhumans-1nu9bv7z5i2), Aug 2026

I'm excited about work on CompassionBench and similar evals, to help better understand how well models are doing on animal welfare -relevant axes

[Forethought](https://manifund.org/projects/forethought), Dec 2025

Forethought’s work has been some of the biggest influence on my safety research work, raising several new areas of research I and some of my collaborators hadn’t previously considered or prioritized. Keep up the amazing work!

[Transluce: Fund Scalable Democratic Oversight of AI](https://manifund.org/projects/transluce-fund-scalable-democratic-oversight-of-ai), Dec 2025

I'm a huge fan of Transluce's work on investigator agents, automated red teaming and jailbreaking, and introducing fresh angles in interpretability/explainability. Their work has consistently been thought-provoking and among the best safety research out there. They also seem to have quite a talented and productive team as well.
